title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create healthy red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. In this article, we'll introduce three delicious and iron-rich, folate-rich recipes that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the baby's brain and spinal cord. To enhance iron absorption, combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods, such as lemons, oranges, or bell peppers.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, bell peppers)
* 1 lemon
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Grill the chicken in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup broccoli
* 1 orange
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Stir-fry the beef in a pan with olive oil and broccoli. Cook the rice in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the orange on top.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Tofu and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g tofu
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, bell peppers)
* 1 lemon
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Cook the tofu in boiling water. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to avoid eating undercooked or raw foods. Ensure that all ingredients are cooked and handled properly before consumption.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, supporting the health of both mother and baby. Remember to combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods to enhance iron absorption. For more information on prenatal nutrition, visit our [meal planner page](/planner) or [read other articles](/blog/topics) on this topic.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide you with personalized guidance and support to ensure your health and your baby's health.
